patterns: Which tech stack do you use?
What backend does your chatbot use?
responses: Destiny uses the MERN stack for the web app and FastAPI with NLP for chatbot services.
Our platform is built using MERN stack along with an AI-powered NLP chatbot using FastAPI.
Destiny offers VR hotel room experiences, travel reviews, doorstep pickup, pay-as-you-travel, and customizable packages.
You can preview hotels in VR, customize trips, and pay only for the days you travel with Destiny.

patterns: What types of trips do you offer?
responses: We offer Adventure, Family, Luxury, and Solo Travel packages.
Our travel packages are categorized into Adventure, Family, Luxury, and Solo travel experiences.
Customizable adventure packages include Kerala Trip and Andaman Scuba Diving.
Non-customizable adventure packages include Rishikesh Adventure Package and Spiti Valley Off-road Bike Travel.
Customizable family packages include Disneyland Paris Family Tour and Japan Cherry Blossom Family Tour.
Non-customizable family packages include Kerala Houseboat Travel and Singapore Universal Studios Tour.
Customizable luxury packages include Maldives Over-water Villa Escape and Bali 5-Star Retreat.
Non-customizable luxury packages include Dubai Ultra High-Luxury Stay and Swiss Alps Premium Experience.
Customizable solo travel packages include Varkala Solo Trekking and Exploring Japan’s Temples and Traditions.
Non-customizable solo packages include Backpacking Through Vietnam and Himalayan Solo Trekking.

patterns: What is pay as you travel?
Do I need to pay full amount?
responses: With Destiny, you only pay for the days you travel. No upfront full payment required.
Our pay-as-you-travel model ensures flexible and transparent pricing.

responses: Yes! Destiny offers VR hotel room experiences so you can explore before booking.
You can preview hotel rooms in virtual reality for a better booking decision.
